headlines.title: AAOI vs. Lumentum: Which Optical Networking Stock Has an Edge Now?
headlines.summary: Applied Optoelectronics benefits from strong AI-driven transceiver demand, but LITE has an edge with superior stock performance, improving profitability, and rising earnings estimates.

headlines.title: Lumentum (LITE) Stock Looks Richly Priced As Its Three Year Run Continues
headlines.summary: Lumentum Holdings has delivered a very strong multi year share price run, capped by sharp swings this year, which naturally raises a question for anyone looking at the stock today. Is the current valuation that traders are paying really supported by its sales, especially after recent news driven moves? Over the past 3 years the share price has risen by a very large amount of about 12x, which puts a lot of weight on whether the revenue base can justify where the stock now trades.

headlines.title: Applied Optoelectronics Climbs 5% on $2.2 Billion Hyperscaler Supply Deal; Lumentum and Coherent Drop 6%
headlines.summary: While AI stocks sell off, one small optical player is rallying on a massive four-year contract from a mystery buyer. But a thin profit, heavy dilution, and a stalled factory expansion raise a harder question about whether it can deliver.

headlines.title: Wall Street’s New M&A Mood: Why Both Marvell-Lumentum and CrowdStrike-Zscaler Hit Pushback
headlines.summary: Two blockbuster AI-era deals landed on strong earnings, yet shareholders balked at both. One buyer got punished far harder than the other, and the reason says a lot about how investors now price consolidation.

headlines.title: JPMorgan U.S. Tech Leaders (JTEK) Sells $27.7 Million of Broadcom on Nov. 20
headlines.summary: The fund's $208.9 million net outflow came from cuts to 35 positions and a single $9.6 million add.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
